newsitem.title: LEBANON: More Lebanese evacuees arrive from Sierra Leone.
newsitem.headline: More Lebanese evacuees arrive from Sierra Leone.

text.p: A third group of 486 Lebanese nationals who escaped the coup in Sierra Leone were flown into Beirut overnight, an airport official said on Wednesday.
"A Middle East Airline jumbo jet arrived late at night from Conakry with 486 Lebanese, mostly women and children, on board," the official said.
The arrivals brought to 908 the number of Lebanese evacuated from the troubled West African country since last Thursday.
According to the Foreign Ministry some 2,000 Lebanese lived in Sierra Leone before the May 25 coup but Minister of Immigrants Talal Arslan said last Friday the total was 9,000, mostly businessmen.

Lebanese officials say many Lebanese are still sheltering in the embassy in Freetown. A woman who arrived in Beirut last week said the status of about 500 Lebanese living outside the capital was unknown.
